ranked.headline: Latent models reconcile batch-affected and incomplete single-cell and spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply deep generative and foundation models to imputation, integration, and demultiplexing of single-cell and spatial omics.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning predicts RNA splicing, translation and regulatory sites
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair learned sequence models with simulation, isoform awareness, and attention architectures for RNA regulation.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks map spatial tissue architecture and regulatory interactions
ranked.summary: Multiplexed imaging and spatial transcriptomics now enable scalable models linking cell neighborhoods to tissue domains and regulatory hubs.

ranked.headline: Coupling generative biomolecular models to explicit free-energy and physical terms
ranked.summary: Energy-based biasing and free-energy estimators are now applied directly to steer biomolecular generation and to rank candidates.

ranked.headline: LLMs embedded in agentic and reasoning pipelines for drug discovery tasks
ranked.summary: Composed LLM agent systems, not base models alone, are now being evaluated across molecular design, perturbation prediction, and proteomics.

ranked.headline: Graph and language-model representations predict biomedical interactions and associations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair explicit relational structure and pretrained language-model embeddings to predict biomolecular and clinical associations.

ranked.headline: Reference tools and pipelines for microbial genomic and metagenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers address amplicon error inflation, reference benchmarks, and containerized pipelines for bacterial and viral profiling.

ranked.headline: Chromatin and methylation maps link noncoding variants to gene regulation
ranked.summary: Single-cell chromatin atlases, silencer scoring and cross-ancestry QTL mapping now resolve variant effects on gene regulation.

ranked.headline: Viral haplotype phasing and error-aware sequence analysis for phylogenetics
ranked.summary: Early-2026 preprints and publications add scalable algorithms that model sequencing errors and amplicon artifacts in microbial and viral genome data.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from tandem mass spectra links unknown metabolites to structures
ranked.summary: Generative structure search, cross-polarity similarity, and mining of 1.32 billion public MS/MS spectra now operate directly on spectral evidence.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biosequence models repurposed for antigenic change and structural homology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study adapt DNA and protein language models for antigenic forecasting, faster homology search, and cheaper tokenization.

ranked.headline: Statistical tools address RNA-seq power, batch effects, meta-analysis, and spatial DE…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers present DESeq2-grounded power analysis, batch-effect metrics, and robust spatial DE tests bearing on study design and data quality.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer expression, lineage and aging states from sparse biomedical data
ranked.summary: Standard-depth cfDNA, mtDNA somatic mutations and sparse single-cell data are now being modeled directly to recover expression, lineage and aging.

ranked.headline: Coarse pocket representations and DEL data advance protein-ligand affinity prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test coarse pocket inputs, DEL-only training, and distance-distribution scoring for protein-ligand binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Multiomic and computational methods define senescent cell states across cell types
ranked.summary: Multi-layer protein and transcript resources and refined single-cell markers now enable systematic detection of senescent cells across tissues.

ranked.headline: Omics-based models predict biological age, circadian time and post-mortem interval
ranked.summary: Routine methylation arrays and blood metabolomics now yield validated predictive models for biological age, circadian time and post-mortem interval.

ranked.headline: LLM agents coupled to scRNA-seq tools and verifiable benchmarks for cell analysis
ranked.summary: Tool-grounded LLM agents and verifiable scRNA-seq benchmarks mark a shift toward checkable, grounded single-cell analysis workflows.

ranked.headline: Harmonized single-cell atlases and graph ML resolve IBD targets and SLE rare cell types
ranked.summary: Harmonized million-cell and 366-sample single-cell atlases now enable ML-driven target and rare cell discovery in IBD and lupus.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models for biomolecular prediction gain standardized benchmarks
ranked.summary: Open structure predictors, peptide benchmarks and transfer-learning retention time models are evaluated against defined reference conditions.

ranked.headline: Machine learning tools for cryo-EM particle selection and RNA structure modeling
ranked.summary: Open RNA motif density datasets and geometry-aware particle filters are emerging to standardize cryo-EM structure modeling and curation.

ranked.headline: Software tools expose hidden conformations, catalytic motifs and drug-binding sites
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 items present open-source tools for structural and proteomic inference from sequence, structure, and MS data.

ranked.headline: Latent medical image representations for glioblastoma prognosis and atlas registration
ranked.summary: Synthetic-data pre-training and self-supervised latent models now yield medical image representations evaluated across many downstream tasks.

ranked.headline: Structure-based computation for kinase selectivity, substrate design and P-gp inhibitors
ranked.summary: Large-scale and active-learning docking now quantify protein reorganization costs and screen P-gp allosteric sites with validation.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve sterol-driven Ca2+ dynamics and cell-cycle protein changes
ranked.summary: Single-cell metabolomics at mass cytometry depth and bulk proteomics deconvolution extend computational inference to new molecular layers.

ranked.headline: Variational autoencoder models of V1 contextual modulation and metabolic firing costs
ranked.summary: Latent-variable generative models are being tested against V1 recordings and ventral-stream object learning to probe biological plausibility.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design sets what performance claims mean in biological prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints audit leakage, saliency validity and statistical inference, pressing for standardized, reportable evaluation in biological models.

ranked.headline: Network and co-essentiality frameworks rank candidate genes for disease and metabolism
ranked.summary: New computational resources rank candidate genes for rare disease, regulation, and metabolism, reporting predictions rather than experimental validation.

ranked.headline: Cloud-deployable workflows automate docking, free energy, and AI molecule evaluation
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 J Chem Inf Model papers describe open or cloud-hosted tools for docking, free energy, and AI-designed molecule evaluation.

ranked.headline: Explicit evolutionary models used to test inference and measure sequence diversity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test coevolution inference and alignment diversity measures against explicit generative models of protein evolution.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata layers and portable packaging for public omics sample and study data
ranked.summary: Reuse of public omics data depends on harmonized annotations and portable packaging, which recent preprints address across cloud and local deployments.

ranked.headline: Forecasting single-cell fate transitions with simulated ground-truth benchmarks
ranked.summary: Snapshot-based forecasting and simulation-derived ground truth are now being paired to evaluate cell fate and trajectory predictions.

ranked.headline: New tools infer population size, merge DNA motifs, and model microbiome disease risk
ranked.summary: Recent software releases extend statistical and neural inference to population genetics, compositional microbiome data, and motif redundancy preprocessing.

ranked.headline: Simulations show tissue-wide planar cell polarity emerges without morphogens
ranked.summary: Recent in silico models test how cell-type alignment and small initial tissue size govern tissue-wide planar cell polarity robustness and patterning.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and metagenomics map Cas9 PAM diversity and bacterial genome evolution
ranked.summary: Sequence-language models and large-scale genome mining now resolve PAM preferences, plasmid content, and SCCmec epistasis in bacterial genomes.

ranked.headline: Web and database platforms pair interactive omics access with structured interpretation
ranked.summary: Recent February 2026 preprints present web and database tools that add interactive access and interpretation over omics data.

ranked.headline: Versioned Software Frameworks for Genealogy, Epidemic and Trajectory Simulation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints release reusable tools for recombination graphs, epidemic simulation and trajectory analysis with documented stability or packaged interfaces.

ranked.headline: Noise-robust functional connectivity and open connectomes for biomarker research
ranked.summary: Noise-robust connectivity from short scans and open, clinically linked connectome releases now enable biomarker analyses on shared data.
